AdbominalPathdology.name: Abdominal Pathology
AdbominalPathdology.description: Focus on surgical and medical conditions of the abdominal cavity.
topics: Anatomy and pathophysiology of the abdominal cavity

Core conditions: appendicitis, cholecystitis, bowel obstruction, peptic ulcer perforation, pancreatitis, peritonitis, GI bleeding, hernia, abdominal trauma, mesenteric ischemia, intra-abdominal tumors
History taking: pain character (SOCRATES), associated symptoms, red flags, relevant PMH, patient communication skills
Physical exam: inspection→auscultation→percussion→palpation, Murphy/Rovsing/Psoas/Obturator signs, peritonism assessment
Diagnostics: labs (CBC/CRP/lipase/lactate), imaging (X-ray/US/CT), scoring systems (Alvarado, Ranson)
Management: triage, conservative vs surgical decision, fluid resuscitation, antibiotic selection, operative indications
